_comment: I5 GeneratedFile-construction ratchet baseline (Invariant I5). Frozen per-package counts of direct GeneratedFile(...) constructor calls in each package's src/ tree (tests/ excluded; datrix-codegen-kernel/.../dgen/executor_files.py excluded as the declared-render path's own internals). Any INCREASE fails datrix/scripts/gates/ratchet/check-generated-file-ratchet.ps1. Decreases are always allowed and should be captured by re-running with --update-baseline once a migration converts hand-coded construction into a DAL generator declaration.
